title: Internal Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The internal energy must be correctly expressed as U = U_0 + nE.

title: Entropy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The entropy S must be derived and expressed as S = 2k[N ln N - n ln n - (N-n) ln(N-n)].

title: Defect Concentration
description: Essential Criteria: The number of defects n must be correctly determined as n = N/(e^(E/2kT) + 1).

title: Combinatorial Count
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the combinatorial counting of states with C_n^N.

title: Limit Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The asymptotic conditions n >> 1 and (N - n) >> 1 must be correctly applied in the entropy derivation.

title: Energy Significance
description: Optional Criteria: The significance of energy E in the context of defect formation should be discussed.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid unit mistakes in the expressions for energy, entropy, and defect concentration.

title: Mathematical Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors in logarithmic identities or combinatorial expressions should be checked.
